blocks.text: Bohat qisam ke bacteria mein flagella hote hain jo unhen harkat karne ke qabil banate hain. Flagella ka doosra (secondary) kaam chemical signals (kemiyai ishaaron) ko mehsoos karna aur un ka jawab dena hai. Jin bacteria mein flagella nahin hote unhen atrichous kehte hain. Jin mein ek sire (pole) par ek hi flagellum ho unhen monotrichous kehte hain. Jin ke ek pole par flagella ka guchha (tuft) ho unhen lophotrichous kehte hain. Jin ke dono poles par flagella hon unhen amphitrichous kehte hain. Jin ke poore cell ke gird flagella hon unhen peritrichous kehte hain (Figure 2.7).

blocks.alt: Paanch rod-shaped cells, har ek ke andar us ka naam: Atrichous bina flagella; Monotrichous ek pole par ek flagellum; Lophotrichous ek pole par flagella ka guchha (tuft); Amphitrichous dono poles par ek ek flagellum; Peritrichous poore cell ke gird flagella.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.7: Bacterial flagella ki mukhtalif tarteebein (arrangements) (kitab ki Figure 2.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.7 mein do tasweeron ke naam aapas mein badal gaye hain: ‘Lophotrichous’ wale cell ke dono siron par ek ek flagellum dikhaya gaya hai aur ‘Amphitrichous’ wale cell ke ek sire par guchha. Kitab ka apna text sahi hai: lophotrichous = ek pole par flagella ka guchha (tuft), amphitrichous = dono poles par flagella. Yahan diagram text ke mutabiq sahi banaya gaya hai.

blocks.text: Bacteria ka flagellum banawat mein eukaryotes ke flagellum se bilkul mukhtalif hai. Yeh microtubules ke 9+2 pattern par nahin bane hote, balke flagellin protein se bane hote hain. Bacterial flagellum ke teen hissay hain: basal body, hook aur filament. Basal body cell membrane ke bilkul neeche hoti hai. Yeh ghoomne wale rings (chhallon) se bani hai (Gram-positive bacteria mein ek jora (pair) aur Gram-negative bacteria mein do jore). Yeh rings flagellum ko cell membrane aur cell wall mein jamaye (anchor kiye) rakhte hain. Hook ek mura hua (curved) hissa hai jo basal body ko filament se jorta hai.

blocks.title: Pili
blocks.text: Kuch bacteria mein pili hote hain (wahid (singular): pilus). Yeh non-helical (spiral nahin), dhaage jaise (filamentous) appendages hain jo flagella se chhote aur patle hote hain. Pili bacteria ko mukhtalif satahon se chipakne (attach hone) ke liye kaam aate hain. Yeh cells ke darmiyan mating (conjugation, yani DNA ke len den) mein bhi hissa lete hain.

blocks.alt: Do panels. Gram-positive bacteria mein flagellum ke hissay: mura hua filament hook ke zariye basal body se jura hai, jis ke rings ka ek jora (pair) moti cell wall ke neeche cell membrane mein hai. Gram-negative bacteria mein flagellum ke hissay: wahi filament aur hook, lekin basal body ke rings ke do jore, ek jora outer membrane aur peptidoglycan mein aur ek jora cell membrane mein. Labels: Filament, Hook, Basal body, Outer membrane, Cell wall, Cell membrane.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.8: Bacterial flagella ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 2.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se upar parhein: basal body (halke neele rings) flagellum ko cell mein jamata (anchor karta) hai aur ghumata hai, hook mura hua jor hai, aur filament lamba dhaga hai jo flagellin protein se bana hai. Farq rings mein hai: Gram-positive (baen) mein sirf ek jora cell membrane mein, Gram-negative (daen) mein do jore, ek outer membrane aur peptidoglycan mein aur doosra cell membrane mein.

blocks.prompt: Bacterial flagellum ke teen hisson ke naam batayein, aur bataiye ke kaunsa hissa Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria mein mukhtalif hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Basal body, hook aur filament. Basal body ke ghoomne wale rings mukhtalif hain: Gram-positive mein rings ka ek jora, Gram-negative mein do jore.

items: Flagella cell ko chalate hain aur chemical signals bhi mehsoos karte hain.
Tarteeb: atrichous (koi nahin), monotrichous (ek pole par ek), lophotrichous (ek pole par guchha), amphitrichous (dono poles par), peritrichous (chaaron taraf).
Bacterial flagellum flagellin protein ka hai, 9+2 microtubules ka nahin: basal body (rings: Gram-positive ek jora, Gram-negative do jore), hook aur filament.
Pili patle, non-helical appendages hain: satah se chipakne aur conjugation ke liye.
